en: Abstract
zh: 摘要

en: This article revisits the debate on the relationship between capitalism and abolition from the perspective of South Asia. It argues that bringing the antislavery debate into conversation with the extensive literature on caste opens up new comparative possibilities. Commercial slavery in the early modern Indian Ocean world is now well established, but global histories of slavery have rarely inspired global histories of antislavery. The dominant interpretation of abolition in South Asia remains focused on the contingent requirements of colonial governance. Through an analysis of legal conflicts over the status of slavery in the eastern Indian province of Bengal in the 1820s and 1830s, I argue that this approach obscures the ethical-political significance of abolition in a context shaped by caste and agrarian slavery. The emancipatory potential of abolition, however, was undermined by a colonial state committed to revenue extraction and social order, as well as by the global capitalist context of counter-revolution. By situating the colonial archive within this wider historical conjuncture, the essay shows how both the possibilities and limits of abolition emerged from the contradictions of liberalism and global capitalism. It thereby puts the South Asian case in conversation with broader histories of revolution and counter-revolution.
zh: 本文从南亚的视角，重新审视资本主义与废奴之间关系的争论。文章认为，将反奴隶制辩论与大量有关种姓的文献置于对话之中，可以打开新的比较可能性。近代早期印度洋世界中商业性奴隶制的存在，如今已得到充分证实；但奴隶制的全球史，很少激发人们撰写反奴隶制的全球史。对南亚废奴的主流解释，仍聚焦于殖民治理因具体情势而产生的需求。通过分析十九世纪二三十年代印度东部孟加拉省围绕奴隶制地位发生的法律冲突，我认为，在一个由种姓与农业奴隶制塑造的情境中，这种研究路径遮蔽了废奴的伦理—政治意义。然而，废奴的解放潜能，一方面受到致力于榨取税收和维持社会秩序的殖民国家的削弱，另一方面也受到全球资本主义反革命背景的压制。本文把殖民档案置于这一更广阔的历史交汇之中，说明废奴的可能性与局限，如何共同产生于自由主义和全球资本主义的矛盾。由此，本文将南亚个案与更广泛的革命、反革命历史联系起来，展开对话。

en: Introduction
zh: 导论

en: In the vast literature on capitalism and abolition stretching back to Eric Williams, South Asian social history is conspicuously absent.

This can partly be explained by the fact that the study of slavery and capitalism was an Atlantic-centered field for much of the twentieth century. In recent decades, however, commercial slavery in the Indian Ocean world has become a prominent field of inquiry.

New Histories of Capitalism and studies of “racial capitalism” have contributed further to a widening of our spatial visions and provoked debates about the global, imperial, and racial dimensions of modern capitalism.
zh: 在可追溯至埃里克·威廉斯的大量资本主义与废奴研究中，南亚社会史明显缺席。
这一点部分可以解释为，在二十世纪的大部分时间里，奴隶制与资本主义研究一直是一个以大西洋为中心的领域。然而，近几十年来，印度洋世界中的商业性奴隶制已成为重要的研究领域。
资本主义新史与“种族资本主义”研究，进一步拓宽了我们的空间视野，并引发关于现代资本主义之全球、帝国与种族维度的辩论。

en: Nevertheless, the new literature on global histories of slavery has not inspired attempts to write global histories of antislavery. Some scholars have called for a better understanding of the slow “drift in community values” that drives authorities to redefine what constitutes coercion, and the need for a global approach to antislavery has occasionally been acknowledged.
Yet, the default interpretation of antislavery in South Asia is one that reads it entirely as a function of the contingent requirements of colonial governance.

Such an approach ignores the possibility that abolition in colonial contexts, despite its limits, had a genuine ethical purchase on the lives of those it affected. Agrarian social relations in the subcontinent were grounded in practices of caste, which involved differential access to markets, land, and water, the control of (bonded) labor, and the regulation of sexuality. As a modality of power, caste was “sited at a depth within the indigenous society, well beyond the reach of the disciplinary arm of the colonial state.”
This dimension has often been concealed, as this essay will also show, through a blending of “indigenous feudal ideology…with colonialist anthropology.”
zh: 然而，新近关于奴隶制全球史的文献，并未激发撰写反奴隶制全球史的尝试。一些学者呼吁，更好地理解推动当局重新界定何为强制的、缓慢发生的“共同体价值观的漂移”；从全球视角研究反奴隶制的必要性，也偶尔得到承认。
但对南亚反奴隶制的默认解释，仍完全将其视为殖民治理因具体情势而产生的需求的函数。
这种路径忽视了一种可能：殖民情境中的废奴尽管有其局限，却仍对其所影响者的生活具有实质性的伦理意义。次大陆的农业社会关系植根于种姓实践，其中涉及对市场、土地与水的不平等获取，对（束缚）劳动的控制，以及对性关系的规制。作为一种权力样态，种姓“深植于本土社会内部，远远超出殖民国家规训之手所能触及的范围”。
正如本文也将说明的，这一维度常常通过“本土封建意识形态……与殖民主义人类学”的混合而被遮蔽。

en: Hence, evacuating abolition in India of its ideological content
produces a major historiographical blind spot.

It occludes from vision longer-running South Asian social histories and the ethical-political valence of abolition in a context shaped by caste and agrarian slavery. Building on Thomas Holt’s insightful distinction between abolitionism as a social ideology irreducible to class interest, and abolitionist “outcomes” produced by elite-imperial policy, the following sections gradually unpack my key argument and its comparative implications.

The next section situates the essay within the broader historiography of capitalism and abolition, and motivates the need to incorporate the specificities of caste and slavery in South Asia into this literature. Section III presents the evidence: a series of legal conflicts and the testimonies of alleged “slaves” in the eastern Indian province of Bengal in the 1820s and 1830s. These disputes show, I argue in Section IV, that slavery was neither a matter of “kinship” nor “gentle” and harmonious.

Agrarian slavery existed in both Mughal South Asia and during the early British colonial era (1765–1858), and there were political struggles over the legal status of slavery in the early nineteenth century. Such aspirations for liberty cannot be explained by colonial state-building alone. Acts of defiance, which included claims of having been “wage” workers rather than “slaves,” and an insistence on the right of property to homesteads, were challenges to the practical basis of caste. Though not textually articulated as such, reading the actions of alleged slaves with reference to a larger structure of inference enables us to better grasp the emergence of an anti-caste and eventually Dalit political subjectivity in South Asia from the 1860s onward.
zh: 因此，
抽空印度废奴的意识形态内容，会造成一个重大的史学盲点。
它使人们看不见南亚更长期的社会史，也看不见在种姓与农业奴隶制塑造的情境中，废奴所具有的伦理—政治意义。托马斯·霍尔特敏锐地区分了两者：一是无法还原为阶级利益的、作为社会意识形态的废奴主义；二是精英—帝国政策产生的废奴“结果”。以下各节将以此为基础，逐步展开我的核心论点及其比较意义。
下一节把本文置于资本主义与废奴的更广泛史学之中，并说明为何必须把南亚种姓与奴隶制的特殊性纳入这一研究。第三节呈现证据：十九世纪二三十年代印度东部孟加拉省的一系列法律冲突，以及被指称为“奴隶”者的证词。我将在第四节论证，这些争议表明，奴隶制既不是“亲属关系”的问题，也并不“温和”、和谐。

农业奴隶制既存在于莫卧儿时期的南亚，也存在于英国殖民统治早期（1765—1858）；十九世纪初，围绕奴隶制法律地位还存在政治斗争。这种对自由的渴望，不能仅以殖民国家的建构来解释。抗拒行为包括声称自己是“雇佣”工人而非“奴隶”，以及坚持对宅基地享有财产权；这些行为挑战了种姓的实践基础。尽管这些行动没有在文本中明确表述为反种姓，借助一个更大的推论结构来解读被指称为奴隶者的行动，仍能帮助我们更好地理解：自十九世纪六十年代起，南亚如何出现反种姓的、并最终形成达利特的政治主体性。

en: The ethical-political potential of abolition, however, was undermined by abolitionist policies enacted by a colonial state deeply invested in “order” and revenue extraction. Indeed, Act V of 1843, which put an end to the legal recognition of slavery but did not actively emancipate the enslaved, can scarcely be called “abolition.” Many historians have recognized and emphasized this point, but the larger, global capitalist context of counter-revolution has not received its due. When “abolition” was effected in India, the forces of reaction were ascendant throughout the wider imperial world
within Europe and Britain.

Colonial officials who governed India also opposed democratic, working-class movements in Britain. “Reform” in the metropole was an attempt to secure the influence of the landed elite in Parliament and to rein in more radical possibilities.

Recognizing the need to situate colonial Jamaica within this broader context, Thomas Holt argued that the gradual rise of racist discourses must be historicized with reference to a context where mass political liberty and the control of labor had become a problem for an entrenched (hence counter-revolutionary) bourgeois-capitalist class.
zh: 然而，废奴的伦理—政治潜能，被一个深度投入于“秩序”和税收榨取的殖民国家所推行的废奴政策削弱了。事实上，1843年第五号法令终止了对奴隶制的法律承认，却没有积极解放受奴役者，因此几乎不能称为“废奴”。许多历史学家已经认识并强调这一点，但更大的全球资本主义反革命背景，却没有得到应有的重视。当印度实施“废奴”时，反动力量在更广泛的帝国世界中，
在欧洲与英国内部占据上风。
治理印度的殖民官员，同样反对英国的民主运动与工人阶级运动。宗主国的“改革”，意在稳固土地精英在议会中的影响力，并约束更激进的可能性。
托马斯·霍尔特认识到，必须把殖民地牙买加置于这一更广泛的背景之中，并指出：应当参照这样一种情境，对种族主义话语的逐渐兴起加以历史化——大众政治自由与对劳动的控制，已经成为根深蒂固、因而具有反革命性质的资产阶级—资本家阶级所面对的问题。

en: I make a similar argument for South Asia by historicizing the wider context of abolition and the colonial archive that is my evidentiary basis. I neither read the archive uncritically nor reject it

Instead, the essay grounds both the possibilities and limits of abolition in the contradictions of liberalism and global capitalism, and asks where South Asia fits within broader histories of capitalism, revolution, and counter-revolution.
zh: 我将废奴的更广泛情境，以及构成本文证据基础的殖民档案加以历史化，从而对南亚提出类似论点。我既不无批判地阅读档案，也不
拒绝档案。相反，本文将废奴的可能性与局限，都根植于自由主义和全球资本主义的矛盾之中，并追问：在资本主义、革命与反革命的更广泛历史中，南亚处于什么位置？

en: Abolition, Capitalism, and the Question of Ideology
zh: 废奴、资本主义与意识形态问题

en: The debates over antislavery in the Atlantic world were intense and impassioned, but all parties agreed on a fundamental point: abolitionism was a major ideological shift, and it was one, if not

most significant, change that set apart the Age of Revolution from preceding epochs. The animating question of the debate was simple yet sweeping: given the remarkable acceptance and stability of slavery across several millennia, how can we explain the emergence of abolitionism and its political success in the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries? No one denied that capitalism had something to do with it, but disagreements abounded about how to conceptualize the link and how to judge the historical and ethical legacy of abolition.
zh: 关于大西洋世界反奴隶制的辩论激烈而充满激情，但各方在一个根本问题上意见一致：废奴主义是一次重大的意识形态转变，即便不是
重要的转变，也是把革命时代与此前各个时代区分开来的关键变化之一。推动这一辩论的问题简单而又宏大：既然奴隶制数千年来一直得到广泛接受并保持稳定，我们该如何解释十八世纪末至十九世纪初废奴主义的出现及其政治成功？没有人否认资本主义与此有关，但如何将这种联系概念化，又如何评价废奴的历史与伦理遗产，意见分歧很大。

en: Eric Williams proposed an elegant, two-part thesis: Atlantic slavery financed British industrialization and was thus foundational for British capitalism; abolition occurred when slavery was no longer profitable and capitalists pushed for “free” wage labor.

Both halves of the thesis were challenged. Economic historians showed that profits from slavery were far less important for British industrialization than Williams assumed, and mechanization was driven by other factors including domestic wage levels and contingent scientific advances.
Seymour Drescher, on the other hand, demonstrated that abolition occurred at a time when profits from slavery were at an all-time high.
Abolition, in short, was “econocide.”
zh: 埃里克·威廉斯提出了一个简洁有力、由两部分构成的命题：大西洋奴隶制为英国工业化提供资金，因此是英国资本主义的基础；当奴隶制不再有利可图，资本家转而推动“自由”雇佣劳动时，废奴便发生了。
这一命题的两个部分都受到挑战。经济史学家表明，奴隶制利润对英国工业化的重要性，远不及威廉斯所假设的程度；机械化由其他因素推动，包括国内工资水平和偶然的科学进展。
另一方面，西摩·德雷舍证明，废奴发生之时，奴隶制的利润正处于历史最高水平。
简言之，废奴是一种“经济自毁”。

en: Some years later, Thomas Haskell re-opened the question of the link between capitalism and humanitarianism in an extended, two-part essay.

He argued that abolition became a practical possibility because the expansion of abstract, formally free market relations enlarged people’s capacity to recognize extended chains of moral responsibility. Thomas Bender rightly observed, however, that it was unclear exactly what Haskell meant by the “market,” and whether he was claiming a new way of valu
, or new

The link between capitalism and humanitarianism remained thin and abstract, and the contingent, political trajectory of abolitionism was left underexamined. Haskell pleaded that he was making a case for “enabling conditions” rather than inevitability, but one could be forgiven for thinking that he was smuggling in economic determinism through the back door.
zh: 若干年后，托马斯·哈斯克尔在一篇分为上下两部分的长文中，重新提出资本主义与人道主义之间联系的问题。
他认为，抽象、形式上自由的市场关系不断扩展，使人们更有能力识别延伸的道德责任链条，因而让废奴成为一种实践上的可能。然而，托马斯·本德恰当地指出，哈斯克尔所谓的“市场”究竟是什么，以及他主张的究竟是一种新的
，还是新的
，并不清楚。
资本主义与人道主义之间的联系，仍然单薄而抽象，废奴主义具体而偶然的政治轨迹也未得到充分考察。哈斯克尔辩称，他论证的是“使之成为可能的条件”，而不是必然性；但人们若认为他是在从后门悄悄引入经济决定论，也并非毫无道理。

en: By contrast, David Brion Davis, in his two magisterial works on slavery and abolition, emphasized both the newness of abolitionism and its moral-political force as an

He showed that a fundamental component of the experience and world-view of the emerging capitalist class that led the abolitionist movement was the question of how to define “freedom” in a rapidly changing world. “Slavery” was a clear-cut and concrete foil, which could be used to symbolize “all the forces that threatened the true destiny of man.”

The ideology of freedom and a principled antislavery position, therefore, could not be reduced to the economic interests of capitalists, but nor could the political trajectory of abolitionism be understood without reference to the actions of elite figures.
zh: 相比之下，戴维·布里昂·戴维斯在关于奴隶制与废奴的两部权威著作中，既强调废奴主义的新颖性，也强调它作为一种
的道德—政治力量。
他表明，领导废奴运动的新兴资本家阶级，其经验与世界观的一个基本组成部分，是如何在迅速变化的世界中定义“自由”的问题。“奴隶制”是一个清晰而具体的对照物，可以用来象征“所有威胁人类真正命运的力量”。
因此，自由的意识形态以及原则性的反奴隶制立场，不能还原为资本家的经济利益；但如果不参照精英人物的行动，也无法理解废奴主义的政治轨迹。

en: Among the early contributors to the debate, Seymour Drescher’s and Thomas Holt’s works offer further insights into how the gap between enabling discourses and actual outcomes might be bridged. Drescher showed that abolitionism became a mass social movement in Britain because it was widely supported by the working classes.

Their empathy for the enslaved was rooted in experiences of exploitation as proletarian workers: they used antislavery ideals to resist further proletarianization and not to uncritically support capitalist expansion. Stadial notions of capitalist development rooted in methodological nationalism, therefore, are ill-equipped to grasp the historical and political complexity of abolitionism, which could have found relevance in purportedly “advanced” as well as “backward” regions.
zh: 在这场辩论的早期参与者中，西摩·德雷舍与托马斯·霍尔特的研究进一步揭示了，如何弥合使某事成为可能的话语与实际结果之间的鸿沟。德雷舍表明，废奴主义之所以在英国成为大众社会运动，是因为它受到工人阶级的广泛支持。
他们对受奴役者的同情，根植于自身作为无产阶级工人遭受剥削的经验：他们运用反奴隶制理想来抵抗进一步的无产阶级化，而非无批判地支持资本主义扩张。因此，植根于方法论民族主义的资本主义阶段发展观，无法很好地把握废奴主义在历史与政治上的复杂性；无论在所谓“先进”还是“落后”的地区，废奴主义都可能具有相关性。

en: Holt sharpened these insights by distinguishing between abolitionism as a social movement and ideology, and abolitionist outcomes shaped by elite politicians and imperial administrators. This enabled him to argue that antislavery was a revolutionary ideology, and even an abolition tempered by a period of “apprenticeship” had a positive impact on the lives of those emancipated. Nevertheless, imperial policy driven by elite interests was always responding to changed contexts. At a historical moment when mass political liberty had become a problem for the entrenched bourgeois-capitalist class in both the metropole and the colonies, and when the need to motivate “lazy” workers had become a recurring theme, emancipated laborers in Jamaica could not be allowed to become independent freeholders exercising franchise. Hence, biologistic theories of “race” became the alibi for repression and disenfranchisement.
zh: 霍尔特区分了作为社会运动和意识形态的废奴主义，与受精英政治家及帝国行政官员塑造的废奴结果，从而使这些洞见更为鲜明。这使他得以论证，反奴隶制是一种革命性意识形态；即使废奴经过一段“学徒期”的缓冲，它仍对获得解放者的生活产生了积极影响。然而，精英利益推动的帝国政策，始终在回应不断变化的情境。在这一历史时刻，大众政治自由已经成为宗主国与殖民地中根深蒂固的资产阶级—资本家阶级的难题，而如何激励“懒惰”工人也已成为反复出现的主题；在这种情况下，牙买加获得解放的劳动者不可能被允许成为行使选举权的独立自耕业主。因此，生物主义的“种族”理论，就成了镇压和剥夺选举权的托辞。

en: Davis, Drescher, and Holt provide a comparative framework for studying abolition beyond the Atlantic world. Yet, the antislavery debate has rarely been invoked when thinking about questions of caste, slavery, and abolition in South Asia. One reason for this is that the contemporary literature on capitalism, slavery, and empire views “capitalism” in primarily negative terms, as historically tied
and often

to slavery, extractive empires, “racialization,” and new forms of gendered domination. This tendency is discernible across the board in the new histories of capitalism, in the large literature on global slavery beyond the Atlantic world, and in the much smaller literature on global abolitionism.

The dialectical approach of an earlier era has been jettisoned in favor of one-sided formulations that threaten to erase both the newness and the ideological force of abolitionism in the Age of Revolution.
zh: 戴维斯、德雷舍和霍尔特，为研究大西洋世界以外的废奴提供了一个比较框架。但在思考南亚的种姓、奴隶制与废奴问题时，人们很少援引反奴隶制辩论。一个原因是，当代关于资本主义、奴隶制与帝国的文献，主要以负面方式理解“资本主义”，认为它在历史上
、而且常常
与奴隶制、榨取型帝国、“种族化”以及新的性别化支配形式相联系。这种倾向遍见于资本主义新史、大量关于大西洋世界之外全球奴隶制的文献，以及规模小得多的全球废奴主义研究。
早期的辩证研究方式被抛弃，取而代之的是片面的表述；这些表述可能抹去革命时代废奴主义的新颖性及其意识形态力量。

en: The existence of widespread commercial slavery in the early modern Indian Ocean world is now universally acknowledged, but we are only beginning to understand how caste was implicated in this process. Some scholars have shown that, in practice, caste and slavery were interrelated, but the social history of caste beyond its colonial framing has been left underexamined.
Moreover, “resistance” is conceptualized far too often as challenges only to extractive European empires.

By leaving open the question of whether resistance was also directed at contradictions within indigenous society, and, if so, with what content, historians have left open the possibility of an uncritical affirmation of pre-colonial South Asian societies.
zh: 如今，近代早期印度洋世界广泛存在商业性奴隶制，已得到普遍承认；但我们才刚开始理解种姓如何卷入这一过程。一些学者说明了种姓与奴隶制在实践中相互关联，但超出殖民框架之外的种姓社会史，仍未得到充分考察。
此外，人们过于频繁地把“抵抗”仅仅概念化为对榨取型欧洲帝国的挑战。
抵抗是否也针对本土社会内部的矛盾？如果是，其内容是什么？历史学家没有回答这些问题，因而留下了无批判地肯定前殖民南亚社会的可能。

en: One example can illustrate the stakes. In the now-established and vibrant field of Dalit studies, scholars often emphasize that Dalits found “colonial” liberalism and modernity useful for addressing their own political concerns, including the problem of representation.

It is also true, however, that the colonial state always allied with upper-caste landed elites to extract revenue and control Dalit labor in the nineteenth century, and it supported Dalit political claims in the early twentieth century solely to undermine nationalist claims to unity.
Moreover, by the 1910s, liberal arguments about property could easily be mobilized to justify the status quo, that is, a caste-differentiated distribution of property.
Therefore, to avoid the extremes of
a one-sided, ahistorical defense of liberalism
an equally one-sided rejection of it

, we must historicize both the potentials and the failures of liberty in South Asia. By combining insights from the Atlantic-centered antislavery debates with the extensive literature on caste, slavery, and agrarian social relations within South Asia, the next two sections sketch the possible outlines for such a historicization.
zh: 一个例子足以说明其中的利害。在如今已经成熟且充满活力的达利特研究领域，学者常强调，达利特发现“殖民的”自由主义与现代性，有助于处理自身的政治关切，包括代表权问题。
然而，同样真实的是，十九世纪殖民国家一直与高种姓土地精英结盟，以榨取税收、控制达利特劳动；而在二十世纪初，它支持达利特的政治诉求，目的仅仅是削弱民族主义关于统一性的主张。
此外，到1910年代，自由主义关于财产的论证，很容易被用来为现状辩护，即为依种姓差异分配财产的格局辩护。
因此，要避免
片面、非历史地捍卫自由主义，
同样片面地将其
拒绝的两个极端，就必须把南亚自由的潜能与失败都加以历史化。接下来两节，将以大西洋为中心的反奴隶制辩论中的洞见，与南亚内部有关种姓、奴隶制和农业社会关系的大量文献相结合，勾勒这种历史化的可能轮廓。

en: The Evidence: Aspirations for Liberty and the Struggle over the Legal Status of Slavery in Bengal, ca. 1813–1843
zh: 证据：对自由的渴望，以及孟加拉围绕奴隶制法律地位的斗争，约1813—1843年

en: On 9 September 1826, in the civil court of Dhaka in eastern Bengal, Golak Narayan Ray filed a suit against Kewal Ram Deo and sixteen others. Ray claimed that Kewal Ram and the others were the descendants of Dakai, Puchai, and Manai, the “hereditary slaves” of Ray’s ancestors.

According to Ray, the defendants and their ancestors had rendered service as slaves to him and his ancestors for generations, “being supported by lands assigned.” The defendants had recently left Ray’s estate and relocated elsewhere. Ray argued that by local custom they remained his hereditary slaves and sued to recover them. The court accepted the suit, and a summons was issued to the defendants.
zh: 1826年9月9日，在东孟加拉达卡的民事法庭，Golak Narayan Ray 对 Kewal Ram Deo 及另外十六人提起诉讼。Ray 声称，Kewal Ram 等人是 Dakai、Puchai 和 Manai 的后代，而这三人是 Ray 先辈的“世袭奴隶”。
据 Ray 所言，被告及其先辈世代作为奴隶为他及其先辈服役，“靠所拨给的土地维生”。被告近来离开 Ray 的地产，迁居他处。Ray 主张，依照当地习俗，他们仍是他的世袭奴隶，并起诉要求将其追回。法庭受理诉讼，向被告发出传票。

en: Appearing for the defendants, Jagannath and Sambunath claimed that their ancestors were rent-paying tenants in the landed estate of Ray and that their “profession” was “service.” Their father was an agent in the estate of the Ray family, and they had never held
lands for sustenance.

At present, the defendants paid Ray, as their “superior landlord,” the “yearly rent of 358 Rupees and 9 annas.” As such, they had full property rights over their person and labor, and Ray’s claim about desertion did not stand. The cause of the complaint, the defendants insisted, was their refusal to hand over to Ray a plot of land that the landlord wished to include in his garden, but in which the defendants had a dwelling of their own. Out of resentment, Ray had brought legal action.
zh: 代表被告出庭的 Jagannath 和 Sambunath 声称，他们的先辈是 Ray 地产上缴纳地租的佃户，其“职业”是“服务”。他们的父亲是 Ray 家族地产的代理人，他们从未持有用于维生的
土地。
当时，被告向作为“上级地主”的 Ray 缴纳“358卢比9安纳的年租”。因此，他们对自己的人身和劳动享有完整的财产权，Ray 关于逃离的主张不能成立。被告坚持认为，诉讼的起因，是他们拒绝把一块土地交给 Ray：地主想将其纳入花园，但被告在该地块上拥有自己的住所。Ray 出于怨恨，遂提起诉讼。

en: Two other defendants, Kewal Ram and Deb Chand, proffered similar defenses, claiming to be tenants rather than slaves. On 23 May 1828, the case came to trial before Mr. D. B. Morrieson. On this occasion, Golak Ray produced an

(pledge or promise) from 1790, which had been executed by Dakai, Puchai, and Manai, and which bore the signature of Mr. W. Douglas, the collector of Jalalpur at the time. Based on this evidence and the testimony of witnesses, Mr. Morrieson passed judgment in favor of the plaintiff and ordered the defendants to be made over to Ray as his slaves. In his judgment, Morrieson pointed out that in the ikrar of 1790, Dakai and his brothers had admitted that they were “hereditary slaves” of the plaintiff’s family. It also showed that Ray’s grandfather had “bought the taluka (tenancy) in their name because they were slaves,” that he “fixed the yearly rent at 370 Rupees 2 annas, and that after allowing them nine rupees from the established rent assets as their nankar for services as slaves, he made it over to their charge.” Further, the ikrar contained a clause that Dakai and his brothers
their descendants would “continue to render service of slaves to the plaintiff,” and that in case of default, the plaintiff had the right to sue.
zh: 另外两名被告 Kewal Ram 和 Deb Chand 提出了类似辩护，声称自己是佃户而非奴隶。1828年5月23日，案件由 D. B. Morrieson 先生开庭审理。在这次庭审中，Golak Ray 提交了一份1790年的

（誓约或承诺），由 Dakai、Puchai 和 Manai 订立，并有当时贾拉尔普尔税收官 W. Douglas 先生的签名。基于这一证据及证人证词，Morrieson 先生判原告胜诉，命令将被告作为奴隶交还 Ray。在判决中，Morrieson 指出，在1790年的 ikrar 中，Dakai 及其兄弟承认自己是原告家族的“世袭奴隶”。该文书还表明，Ray 的祖父“因为他们是奴隶，所以以他们的名义购买了 taluka（租佃权）”；他“将年租固定为370卢比2安纳，并在从既定租收中拨出9卢比，作为他们服奴役的 nankar 津给之后，将其交由他们管理”。此外，ikrar 还包含一项条款：Dakai 及其兄弟
他们的后代将“继续为原告服奴役”；如有违约，原告有权起诉。

en: The defendants then filed an appeal at the Provincial Court of Appeal, and their case was heard on 9 November 1829, by Mr. W. Cracoft. The judge reversed the decree of the lower court, and he even cast doubt on the ikrar of 1790 that had been the key evidentiary basis of the previous judgment. Cracoft found the deed suspicious, doubted its provenance, and concluded that the defendants were more likely tenants than slaves. His position, however, was contradicted by Mr. Charles Smith, a judge of the same court, who next heard the case on 29 December 1829.
zh: 随后，被告向省上诉法院提起上诉；1829年11月9日，W. Cracoft 先生审理了该案。这位法官撤销了下级法院的判令，甚至质疑作为前次判决关键证据的1790年 ikrar。Cracoft 认为该契据可疑，对其来源存疑，并断定被告更可能是佃户而非奴隶。然而，同一法院的另一位法官 Charles Smith 先生，于1829年12月29日接着审理该案时，提出了相反看法。

en: Smith believed the ikrar to be true, and he saw no reason to question its veracity. His sweeping comments demonstrate the presumptive attitudes of many judges: “Slavery of a family may be

; and it seldom happens, that after the lapse of many years, the original title, shewing acquisition of the slave’s forefather, is forthcoming. In this part of the country, many slaves are apparently persons of respectability and educated, and manage the

[estate] affairs of their masters. But this constitutes no ground for emancipation. In a word, the appellants and their ancestors are the hereditary slaves of the respondent, and if discharged, notwithstanding proof of their servile state, most slaves will become recusant, and on various pretexts will find means to effect their discharge.”
zh: Smith 相信 ikrar 为真，认为没有理由质疑其真实性。他笼统的评论，展示了许多法官先入为主的态度：“一个家族的奴隶身份，可以

children: 从持续服役中推断出来

zh: ；多年过去之后，能够证明最初如何取得奴隶先辈的原始权利凭证，通常很难再找到。在本国这一地区，许多奴隶看上去是有身份、有教养的人，并为主人管理
［地产］事务。但这并不构成解放的理由。总而言之，上诉人及其先辈是被上诉人的世袭奴隶；如果在已有证据证明其奴隶地位的情况下仍将他们释放，那么大多数奴隶都会变得不服从，并以各种借口设法取得解脱。”

en: Due to such disagreements among judges, the case went to the Murshidabad Court of Appeal to be heard by a third judge. On 20 April 1830, Mr. C. W. Steer confirmed the judgment of Mr. Smith, and the appellants then requested the highest civil court—the Sadar Dewani Adalat (SDA)—for permission to file a special appeal. This was granted on 21 June 1830, by Mr. Alexander Ross and Mr. R. H. Rattray.
zh: 由于法官之间存在这样的分歧，案件被移交穆尔希达巴德上诉法院，由第三位法官审理。1830年4月20日，C. W. Steer 先生确认了 Smith 先生的判决。上诉人随后请求最高民事法院——Sadar Dewani Adalat（简称SDA）——准许提起特别上诉。1830年6月21日，Alexander Ross 先生与 R. H. Rattray 先生批准了这一请求。

en: The tone of the SDA judges was diametrically opposed to many in the lower courts. Mr. Rattray, on 26 March 1832, concurred with Mr. Cracoft and with the grounds of his judgment. Moreover, when the lawyers of Ray pointed out that one of the appellants, Kalikinkar, had died, and insisted that his heirs be summoned to follow up on the appeal, Mr. Rattray argued that there was no need to summon them if “death had emancipated [Kalikinkar].” Mr. Ross, on 5 May 1832, finalized the judgment of Mr. Rattray and added that the “service” of slaves and of dependent tenants had to be clearly distinguished. He felt that the appellants had been the latter, who held land “on condition of paying a fixed rent and rendering service.” As long as they held the lands and gained sustenance from them, they had to render service, but “not after abandoning the tenure and thereby discharging themselves.” Thus, “he who has the power to emancipate himself, cannot be considered a slave.”
zh: SDA法官的基调，与许多下级法院法官截然相反。1832年3月26日，Rattray 先生赞同 Cracoft 先生及其判决理由。此外，当 Ray 的律师指出一位上诉人 Kalikinkar 已经死亡，并坚持应传唤其继承人继续上诉时，Rattray 先生认为，如果“死亡已经解放了［Kalikinkar］”，便没有必要传唤他们。1832年5月5日，Ross 先生最终确认了 Rattray 先生的判决，并补充说，必须明确区分奴隶与依附佃户所提供的“服务”。他认为，上诉人属于后者，持有土地的条件是“缴纳固定地租并提供服务”。只要他们持有土地并依靠土地维生，就必须提供服务；但“放弃租佃权并由此解除自身义务之后，便不再如此”。因此，“有能力使自己获得解放的人，不能被视为奴隶”。

en: Such conflicts were extremely common. While peasant rebellions and the question of peasant consciousness in early colonial Bengal have attracted scholarly attention for decades, the actions of slaves and the nature of their claims in legal cases have not been systematically studied.
Only a few monographs exist on slavery in early colonial Bengal, and none of them address the question of slave consciousness directly.
Yet, alleged “slaves” often expressed outrage against their masters. In the year 1813 alone, they filed 150 cases in colonial courts, which may have represented only the tip of the iceberg.

A. D. Campbell, who served as a Superintendent of Police and then as a Magistrate, noted that a slave’s “peculiar situation, want of relatives and friends,” and “general ignorance and poverty” must have prevented very many from seeking redress against their wealthy and powerful masters.

Despite such unfavorable odds, alleged slaves began claiming property rights to their homesteads in that very year. The boldness and novelty of such claims were noted by missionaries who had just been allowed into British territories by the East India Charter Act of 1813.
zh: 这类冲突极为常见。早期殖民孟加拉的农民叛乱与农民意识问题，数十年来一直受到学者关注；但奴隶的行动及其在诉讼中所提出主张的性质，却尚未得到系统研究。
有关早期殖民孟加拉奴隶制的专著只有少数几部，而且没有一部直接处理奴隶意识的问题。
然而，被指称为“奴隶”的人，常常表达对主人的愤怒。仅1813年，他们便在殖民法院提起150起诉讼，而这可能只是冰山一角。
先后担任警察总监与地方行政司法官的 A. D. Campbell 指出，奴隶的“特殊处境、缺少亲友”，以及“普遍的无知与贫困”，必然阻碍了许多人向富有而强大的主人寻求救济。
尽管条件如此不利，被指称为奴隶的人仍在那一年开始主张对宅基地的财产权。传教士注意到了这些主张的大胆与新颖；他们刚刚依据1813年《东印度特许状法》，获准进入英国统治的领土。

en: The judgment passed in the conflict discussed above became a precedent. In another instance in Dhaka in 1831, a slaveholder—Gauri Sankar Roy—filed a suit to recover runaway slaves.

Two of the defendants—Kirti Narayan and Sri Narayan Deo—appeared to testify and made identical claims about being tenants rather than slaves. The Narayan brothers insisted that their father, Binod Ram, was “free and earned his livelihood as a cultivator and tenant of land and by service.”

After the demise of their father, the brothers continued to hold lands as tenants on the estate of the plaintiff and paid rent. Notably, the plaintiff in his reply alleged that by the custom of the country, if

or household slaves cultivated for rent lands of their master more than those assigned for their support, such fact did not discharge them of their liabilities as slaves. On 24 August 1832, the Principal Sadar Amin agreed with the plaintiff and ordered all thirteen defendants to be made over to Gauri Sankar as his slaves. Subsequently, Kirti Narayan went in person to the Sadar Dewani Adalat on 21 February 1833 and asked for a special appeal to be admitted. Crucially, the ground for his request was that the decision in this case was contrary to the judgment passed by the SDA on 5 May 1832 in the previous case, that is, Golak Narayan Ray vs. Kewal Ram Deo and others. The SDA’s hand was forced, and the appeal was admitted by Mr. Rattray on 23 March 1833. Gauri Sankar Roy—the slaveholder—was asked to justify his claim. In response, Roy asserted that the appellants had received not only lands from him for their sustenance but also rations and other aids. He also insisted that the “want of a bill of sale after the lapse of ages” could not affect his right as a master. Slavery of the appellants was proved by the “continuity of hereditary service,” as well as the evidence adduced regarding the support received by the servants.
zh: 前述冲突中的判决成为一个先例。1831年达卡的另一案件中，奴隶主 Gauri Sankar Roy 起诉要求追回逃离的奴隶。
两名被告 Kirti Narayan 和 Sri Narayan Deo 出庭作证，也同样主张自己是佃户而非奴隶。Narayan 兄弟坚持说，他们的父亲 Binod Ram 是“自由的，靠务农、租佃土地和提供服务谋生”。
父亲去世后，兄弟俩继续以佃户身份持有原告地产上的土地，并缴纳地租。值得注意的是，原告在答辩中声称，依本地习俗，如果

或家内奴隶除了耕种分配给他们维生的土地外，还付租耕种主人的其他土地，这一事实并不解除他们作为奴隶的义务。1832年8月24日，Principal Sadar Amin法官同意原告的主张，命令将全部十三名被告作为奴隶交还 Gauri Sankar。随后，1833年2月21日，Kirti Narayan 亲自前往 Sadar Dewani Adalat，请求受理特别上诉。关键在于，他请求的理由是：本案判决违背了SDA在前案——Golak Narayan Ray诉Kewal Ram Deo等人——中于1832年5月5日作出的判决。SDA因此不得不采取行动，Rattray 先生于1833年3月23日受理了上诉。奴隶主 Gauri Sankar Roy 被要求证明自己的主张。他答称，上诉人不仅从他那里获得维生土地，还获得口粮与其他帮助。他还坚持，“年代久远之后买卖契据的缺失”，不能影响他作为主人的权利。上诉人的奴隶身份，可由“世袭服役的连续性”，以及仆役得到供养的相关证据加以证明。

en: Mr. Rattray, however, was not swayed. He proposed to reverse the decree of the lower court and passed his judgment on 7 August 1833, pointing out that the lack of a deed of sale and the lack of proof that the appellants held lands in return for hereditary service made Roy’s claim weak. More importantly, the judge made a new argument by insisting that even if such lands had been held in return for service, once the slaves quit such lands, “they cease[d] to be liable to any claim of servitude.” Acknowledging that the appellants were probably

slaves, that is, those who offered themselves in servitude for the sake of food, Rattray nevertheless insisted that “when the slave for his food abandons the service, he becomes free.” These opinions were confirmed by Mr. G. Stockwell when he heard the case on 7 December 1835, and thus the alleged slaves were emancipated.
zh: 然而，Rattray 先生并未动摇。他主张撤销下级法院的判令，并于1833年8月7日作出判决，指出缺少买卖契据，也缺少上诉人以世袭服役为条件持有土地的证据，因此 Roy 的主张薄弱。更重要的是，这位法官提出了一项新论点：即便这些土地曾以服役为条件持有，一旦奴隶放弃土地，“他们便不再负有任何奴役请求所主张的义务”。Rattray 承认，上诉人可能属于
奴隶，即为获取食物而自愿服役的人；但他仍坚持，“当以食物为条件的奴隶放弃服役时，他便成为自由人”。1835年12月7日，G. Stockwell 先生审理此案时确认了这些意见，被指称为奴隶的人因此获得解放。

en: An almost identical case reached the SDA in 1835 from the frontier district of Mymensingh, where a monumental peasant rebellion (1826–1833) had just concluded.

The slaveholder claimed that the defendants had served him as slaves in return for access to land. The alleged slaves rejected such an ascription and claimed that they had occasionally served the appellant and used some land, but only “in place of wages.” Now, after some years of service, they had decided to move to another village because they were treated there as “tenants.” A familiar back-and-forth between several courts and judges followed. Eventually, the case arrived at the SDA, and the final decision was passed by Mr. Stockwell on 17 May 1836. He acknowledged that the defendants may have been slaves in consideration of lodging and lands for support. It was also clear, however, that they had “abandoned such lodging and support.” Citing his judgment of 7 December 1835 in the case of Gauri Sankar Roy vs. the Narayan brothers as a precedent, Stockwell concluded that the respondents were “slaves of the class of slaves for their food.” On surrender of the lands held, therefore, they were “entitled to emancipation.” Soon after, another identical case from Sylhet was admitted into the SDA, although the decision in that instance did not go in favor of the alleged slaves for technical reasons.
zh: 1835年，一个几乎完全相同的案件，从边疆地区迈门辛来到SDA；该地区一场规模巨大的农民叛乱（1826—1833）刚刚结束。

奴隶主声称，被告以奴隶身份为他服役，换取使用土地的权利。被指称为奴隶的人拒绝这种身份归属，声称他们偶尔为上诉人提供服务并使用一些土地，但这只是“代替工资”。如今，在服务若干年后，他们决定搬往另一个村庄，因为在那里他们被当作“佃户”。此后，案件照例在多个法院与法官之间往返。最终，它来到SDA，Stockwell 先生于1836年5月17日作出终局判决。他承认，被告可能是以住所和维生土地为对价的奴隶；但同样清楚的是，他们已经“放弃了这种住所与供养”。Stockwell 援引自己在1835年12月7日对 Gauri Sankar Roy诉Narayan兄弟一案的判决作为先例，认定被上诉人属于“为食物而为奴的一类奴隶”。因此，在交还所持土地后，他们“有权获得解放”。不久，SDA又受理了一个来自锡尔赫特的相同案件，但由于技术性原因，那次判决未能有利于被指称为奴隶的人。

en: The trajectory of these cases shows that there was no consensus among judges and hence no coherent colonial policy regarding legal disputes over the status of “slaves.” Indeed, the Indian Law Commission’s report acknowledged that there was a great variety of opinion and practice on this matter and such variety was observable not only in different and distant parts of the country, but even in neighboring districts, and “sometimes [in] different divisions of the same district, and even at different times in the same court.”

Some officials admitted the legal standing of slavery and the rights and obligations arising out of it, whereas others rejected it entirely. And even among those who recognized slavery, “some would confine its existence within the bounds prescribed by the Mahomedan and Hindoo laws, others would extend it over the wider field of custom and usage; as Magistrates, some would render assistance to the master to recover his fugitive slaves, others would abstain from any interference; some would permit to the master the right of moderate correction, others would not countenance the exercise of such authority.”
The law, in short, was in a “defective” state, and it lacked “clear rules” that could guide judgments.
zh: 这些案件的进程表明，法官之间不存在共识，因而对于围绕“奴隶”地位的法律争议，也不存在统一的殖民政策。事实上，印度法律委员会的报告承认，这一问题上的意见与实践差异极大；差异不仅出现在本国相距遥远的不同地区，即使在相邻地区，“有时在同一地区的不同分区，甚至同一法院的不同时间”，也同样存在。
一些官员承认奴隶制的法律地位，以及由此产生的权利和义务，另一些则完全拒绝承认。即便在承认奴隶制的人当中，“有些人将其存在范围限制在穆罕默德法与印度教法规定的界限之内，另一些则将其扩展至习俗与惯例的更广领域；作为地方行政司法官，有些人帮助主人追回逃亡奴隶，另一些则不作任何干预；有些人准许主人享有适度惩戒的权利，另一些则不认可这种权力的行使”。
简言之，法律处于“有缺陷”的状态，缺少能够指导判决的“明确规则”。

en: Moreover, the defective state of the law and the ensuing confusion were partly a function of contradictions
to “Hindu” law. Based on classical texts including those of Manu, Vrihaspati, and Narada, Brahman (the uppermost, priestly caste)
(scholars) had provided the colonial state with a list of fifteen classes of legal slaves in Hindu law.
That list, however, raised more questions than it answered. For example, how would one distinguish in practice between
slaves, or those who offered themselves in servitude for the sake of food, and

slaves, that is, those who sold themselves for a price? People who entered servitude out of economic distress often received more than just food from their masters, and the question remained whether those additional benefits should be considered a “price” or not. The distinction mattered because, according to the pandits themselves, a
slave could be emancipated upon relinquishing his subsistence, but a self-sold slave could never become free without the will of the master.
In the cases narrated above, the masters did not conceive of their slaves as
, and neither did some colonial officials, but fortunately for the alleged slaves, the highest-ranking judges did.
zh: 此外，法律的缺陷状态及由此产生的混乱，部分源于“印度教”法
的矛盾。依据包括摩奴、Vrihaspati与那罗陀著作在内的经典文本，婆罗门（最高的祭司种姓）
（学者）向殖民国家提供了一份清单，列出印度教法中的十五类合法奴隶。
但这份清单提出的问题，多于它回答的问题。例如，在实践中，如何区分
奴隶，即为获取食物而自愿服役的人，与

All three categories or a combination of them could easily be applicable in a particular case, but the rules of emancipation (according to the Brahmans) were different for the different categories. A remark on this point by the Officiating Magistrate of Rangpur is insightful: “In ninety cases out of the hundred, the servile status of slaves originated either by their forefathers having made themselves bondsmen by borrowing small sums of money (which bondage ought to have expired with their lives), or the descendants of cultivators who have died in debt, either to the zamindars, or persons holding small farms under them: as experience has proved to me, neither would scruple to compel the widows or children of their deceased bondsmen, or insolvent deceased cultivators, to give them written engagements of being slaves or bondsmen for life; and this instrument would cause the parties and their descendants to become slaves in perpetuity.”

en: It was thus difficult, if not impossible, to know for certain exactly how servile statuses originated, and whether they involved coercion or not. In many parts of Bengal, these kinds of cases were in the clear majority, which shows that the alleged slaves in the conflicts discussed above may well have been tenants at some point.
zh: 因此，奴役地位究竟如何起源、是否涉及强制，要确切知晓这一点，即使并非不可能，也十分困难。在孟加拉的许多地方，这类案件占绝大多数，这说明，前述冲突中被指称为奴隶的人，在某一时期完全可能曾是佃户。

Moreover, women cohabiting with any type of slave necessarily acquired servile status. Without doubt, this was a strategy to reproduce servitude, but it is clear that by the 1820s and 1830s, descendants of erstwhile slaves did not want to put up with it. In all of the cases discussed above, the masters were trying to ascribe servile status to the descendants of those who
have been slaves to their families, but the new generations resisted. When colonial judges decided to emancipate the alleged slaves in these cases by treating them as

en: In other cases, too, this problem reared its head, and the decisions passed by the colonial state were significant. In 1831, the courts had to resolve a conflict from a district that falls in modern-day Jharkhand and borders western Bengal. The plaintiff alleged that his forebears had purchased some slaves during the great famine of 1769–70 and that he was filing the suit to recover as his slaves those who were the descendants of the original
slaves two generations removed.

In response, the defendants claimed that their ancestors had never sold themselves into slavery but rather had received “loans” of coarse grains and other foodstuffs that had since been repaid. The plaintiff shot back, saying that in a famine “no one supported another,
, for the mere acknowledgment of grain or money.”
Eventually, the case was decided against the plaintiff because the bill of sale provided was written on plain paper, which the courts found suspicious.
zh: 在其他案件中，这一问题也浮现出来，殖民国家作出的裁决具有重要意义。1831年，法院必须解决一场来自某地区的冲突；该地位于今天的贾坎德邦，与孟加拉西部接壤。原告声称，其先辈在1769—1770年大饥荒期间购买了一些奴隶；如今他提起诉讼，是为了把最初那些
奴隶隔了两代的后裔，作为自己的奴隶追回。
被告回应称，他们的先辈从未卖身为奴，只是曾“借入”粗粮及其他食物，而这些借项早已归还。原告反驳说，在饥荒中，“没有人会仅仅因为对方承认欠下谷物或钱款，就供养另一个人，

en: Another conflict from the frontier district of Sylhet in 1826 had an identical structure: the slaveholder alleged desertion, but the alleged slaves responded that they were tenants.

In this case, a genuine bill of sale from 1757 was produced. The question was whether the presence of a clause stating that the person was selling himself for “sixty and seventy years of service” meant that after that term, his remaining descendants should be considered free. One judge claimed that the limitation of time was merely in conformance with “custom” and was meant to ensure the “exemption from labor in old age, not freedom.” Others countered that when a person sold himself for a stipulated period, it could scarcely imply that his wife, son, and further descendants “should pass as owned persons, and be liable to render service to the issue of the hirers.” The alleged slaves were eventually emancipated, but this was done

这一案件中，提交了一份1757年的真实买卖契据。问题在于，契据有一条说，当事人卖身是为了提供“六十年和七十年的服务”；这是否意味着，期限届满后，仍在世的后代应被视为自由人？一位法官声称，这一期限只是遵照“习俗”，目的在于确保“年老时免于劳动，而非获得自由”。另一些人反驳说，一个人按规定期限出卖自身，几乎不可能意味着其妻、子及更后代“应作为被拥有的人转移，并有义务为雇用者的后代服役”。被指称为奴隶的人最终获得解放，但这一结果，

en: We see, then, that at least some colonial officials were upholding the undeniably modern idea that individuals cannot be held responsible for the sins and debts of their forebears. When judges decided to emancipate slaves, they usually did so either by playing on the nebulousness and overlapping of definitions or by going beyond the ambit of Hindu law as prescribed by the Brahmans. It is also clear, however, that this was not colonial benevolence but rather a response to pressures from below by alleged slaves. The evidence suggests that descendants of erstwhile slaves primarily sought property rights over their bodies and labor. They wanted to be able to choose where, how, and under whom they would work, and they preferred contractual relationships of “loans” and “wages” over the paternalism of a master-slave relationship. This was a rejection of caste norms as well because we know that at least in the far-eastern districts of Mymensingh and Sylhet, nankar lands were given for subsistence to the lowest castes.

The disputes show that the alleged slaves wanted to be able to move freely whenever they wanted to, especially in eastern Bengal, where land was still plentiful, and where the frontier was closed only in the late nineteenth century.
Slaves, in short, preferred the legal status of tenants or “raiyats,” even if that meant being
raiyats for a time, that is, raiyats who migrate often and are not permanently settled in a particular village.
zh: 因此，我们看到，至少一些殖民官员支持一种无疑具有现代性的观念：个人不能为先辈的罪过与债务承担责任。法官决定解放奴隶时，通常或者利用定义的模糊与重叠，或者越过婆罗门所规定的印度教法的范围。然而，同样清楚的是，这并非殖民者的仁慈，而是回应被指称为奴隶者自下而上的压力。证据显示，昔日奴隶的后代，主要寻求对自身身体与劳动的财产权。他们希望能够选择在哪里、如何以及在谁手下工作；相较于主奴关系的家长主义，他们偏好“贷款”与“工资”的契约关系。这也是对种姓规范的拒绝，因为我们知道，至少在最东部的迈门辛与锡尔赫特地区，nankar土地是分配给最低种姓用于维生的。
这些争议表明，被指称为奴隶的人，希望在任何自己愿意的时候自由迁移；尤其在东孟加拉，土地仍然充裕，直到十九世纪末边疆才封闭。
简言之，奴隶更愿意具有佃户或“raiyats”的法律地位，即便这意味着暂时成为
raiyats，即经常迁徙、没有在某个特定村庄永久定居的佃户。

en: Making Sense of the Evidence: Abolition and Counter-Revolution in Colonial Bengal, 1772–1843
zh: 理解这些证据：殖民孟加拉的废奴与反革命，1772—1843年

en: To interpret this evidence, we must consider the trajectory and contradictions of colonial governance, as well as the

history of the society being governed. Certainly, ambivalence about questions of slavery and caste was a constant feature of colonial policy from the 1770s onward. There was an abolitionist impulse, which found expression in periodic regulations aimed at curtailing the slave trade in the Indian Ocean. In 1774, commerce in slaves within the territories of the British East India Company (EIC) was banned. In 1789, the export of slaves was prohibited and imports were eventually outlawed in 1811.

Such measures were only partially successful because the slave trade was extremely lucrative, and the company failed to prevent its servants from participating in the trade and from owning slaves. The deeper problem, however, was the company’s legislative measures.
zh: 要解释这些证据，必须考察殖民治理的轨迹与矛盾，以及被治理社会的
历史。可以确定的是，自十八世纪七十年代起，对奴隶制与种姓问题的矛盾态度，一直是殖民政策的特点。一种废奴冲动确实存在，表现为不时颁布旨在限制印度洋奴隶贸易的法规。1774年，英国东印度公司（EIC）领土内部的奴隶交易被禁止。1789年，奴隶出口遭到禁止；到1811年，进口也终于被宣布非法。
这些措施只有部分成效，因为奴隶贸易利润极高，公司未能阻止其雇员参与交易和拥有奴隶。然而，更深层的问题在于公司自身的立法措施。

en: In 1772, Governor-General Warren Hastings sanctioned slavery in British India as a penal measure.

The ostensible aim was to prevent “hereditary” robbers by enslaving entire families and putting them to work. As the Court of Directors put it, the robbers causing havoc across the company territories were “wretches who have placed themselves in a state of declared war with Government, and are, therefore, wholly excluded from every benefit of its laws.”

Crucially, when justifying the use of slavery to combat robbery, the state introduced the distinction between the “evil” character of Atlantic slavery and the “mild” character of its Indian counterpart. In India, apparently, slaves were “treated as the children of families to which they belong; and often acquire a

children: much happier state by their slavery than they could have hoped for by the enjoyment of liberty.

en: Another mode of justification was the grounding of slavery in the “religious” laws of “Hindus” and “Muslims,” which necessarily implicated “caste” in the colonial discourse on (Hindu) slavery.
zh: 1772年，总督沃伦·黑斯廷斯批准在英属印度将奴隶制用作刑罚措施。
其表面目的是，通过把整个家庭变为奴隶并强迫他们劳动，防范“世袭”盗匪。正如董事会所说，那些在公司领土上四处作乱的盗匪，是“已经把自己置于公开与政府交战状态的恶棍，因此被完全排除在政府法律的一切惠益之外”。
关键在于，国家为用奴隶制打击盗匪辩护时，引入了大西洋奴隶制的“邪恶”性质与印度奴隶制的“温和”性质之间的区分。据说，在印度，奴隶“被当作所属家庭的子女来对待；而且常常因为为奴，反倒获得了
