zh: 另一种辩护方式，是把奴隶制建立在“印度教徒”与“穆斯林”的“宗教”法律之上；这必然将“种姓”卷入关于（印度教）奴隶制的殖民话语。

en: The state first connected caste to religion in 1772, when it decided that in all matters pertaining to inheritance, marriage, and other religious usages and institutions, the laws of the Koran concerning Muslims and those of the “Shaster” (sic) with respect to the Hindus would be followed. The exposition of the law was left to the Maulvis for Muslims, and the Brahmans for Hindus, thereby entrenching an upper-caste point of view as law. In 1793, Hindu and Muslim laws of marriage, caste, succession, and inheritance were upheld again by the Marquis Cornwallis. But the question of whether Hindu and Muslim laws of
should also be upheld, and whether slavery should be deemed a domain of “religious” practice of the two communities, was still open.
The matter was settled arbitrarily in 1798 when the Sadar Dewani Adalat decreed that the

, if not the letter, of the 1772 and 1793 decisions suggested that Islamic and Hindu laws should also apply to cases of slavery, and this was confirmed by the Governor-General on 12 April 1798. Until legal non-recognition of slavery by Act V of 1843, this remained the shaky foundation upon which slavery in British India rested.
zh: 1772年，国家首次把种姓与宗教联系起来，决定在有关继承、婚姻及其他宗教习俗与制度的一切事务中，穆斯林遵循《古兰经》的法律，印度教徒则遵循“Shaster”（原文如此）的法律。法律解释由穆斯林的Maulvis和印度教徒的婆罗门承担，由此将高种姓的观点固化为法律。1793年，康沃利斯侯爵再次维护印度教与伊斯兰的婚姻、种姓、承继及财产继承法律。但是否也应维护印度教与伊斯兰有关
的法律，以及奴隶制是否应被视为两个共同体的“宗教”实践领域，仍是悬而未决的问题。
1798年，Sadar Dewani Adalat 武断地作出裁定，认为即使不是字面条文，1772年和1793年决定的
也表明，伊斯兰与印度教法律应适用于奴隶制案件；总督于1798年4月12日确认了这一裁定。直到1843年第五号法令不再从法律上承认奴隶制之前，这始终是英属印度奴隶制赖以存在的不稳固基础。

en: In truth, the 1798 decision followed logically from the ones made in 1772 and 1793 because caste

correlated to slavery, and if the former could be deemed a religious usage, then why not the latter? At the time, caste and slavery functioned as overlapping yet distinct modalities of labor control in Bengal: the number of “impure” castes set the upper limit to the total number of agrarian slaves, because “pure” castes could be domestic slaves to castes of the same or higher status, but they could not be agrarian slaves.

Witnesses belonging to multiple castes arrived at the same conclusion in their testimonies to the colonial state, and Brahman witnesses went to great lengths to emphasize that only some castes were “fit” for some kinds of work. Vishnu Dutt Dalli, for instance, testified on 5 February 1839 that slaves of the “low-ranked” Chandala, Dom, Hera, and Kumar castes could only be employed in outdoor work.
zh: 其实，1798年的决定在逻辑上延续了1772年与1793年的决定，因为种姓
与奴隶制相联系；如果前者可被视为宗教习俗，那么后者为何不可？当时，在孟加拉，种姓与奴隶制作为彼此重叠却又不同的劳动控制样态运作：“不洁”种姓的人数，规定了农业奴隶总人数的上限，因为“洁净”种姓可以成为同等或更高种姓的家内奴隶，却不能成为农业奴隶。
多个种姓的证人，在向殖民国家作证时得出了相同结论；婆罗门证人更竭力强调，只有某些种姓才“适合”某些工作。例如，Vishnu Dutt Dalli 于1839年2月5日作证说，来自“低等”的Chandala、Dom、Hera和Kumar种姓的奴隶，只能从事户外工作。

en: Within the framework of early colonial law, therefore, one could insist that slavery was

a domain of religious practice only in two ways: either accept that caste was also not just a religious institution but one that had a fundamentally secular basis, or artificially separate the question of slavery from the larger set of social relations within which it was embedded. The former was never done, and the latter course was followed in the run-up to 1843.
zh: 因此，在早期殖民法律框架内部，只有两条路径可以坚持奴隶制
宗教实践领域：或者承认种姓也不只是宗教制度，而是具有根本世俗基础的制度；或者人为地把奴隶制问题从它所嵌入的更广泛社会关系中分离出来。前一条路从未被采取；通向1843年的过程中，走的是后一条路。

en: Legal conflicts between alleged slaves and their masters became a pressing issue by the 1810s. John Richardson, the District Judge and Magistrate of Bundelkhand, and William Leycester, a judge of the Committee of Circuit, argued for complete abolition in 1808 and 1815, respectively.

Chief Justice John Harrington sharpened the case for intervention with a poignant question in 1818. How, he asked, could slaves hope to attain the liberty they desired when they were “possessed of and [could] acquire no property to enable them to institute or defend a suit” and when they could be subjected to restraint or even confinement while suits were pending?

The case for abolition, however, was summarily rejected by a state deeply invested in extracting revenue and maintaining “order.” Acting Governor-General John Adam (January–August 1823) and his successor William Amherst (1823–1828) both concurred that slavery was interwoven with the “customs and feelings” of the people. Intervention, therefore, would only wreak discontent and it was inexpedient to hazard the inconvenience.
zh: 到1810年代，被指称为奴隶者与主人之间的法律冲突，已成为迫切问题。本德尔坎德地区法官兼地方行政司法官 John Richardson，与巡回委员会法官 William Leycester，分别于1808年和1815年主张彻底废奴。
1818年，首席法官 John Harrington 以一个尖锐的问题，进一步加强了干预的理由。他问：当奴隶“不拥有、也无法取得任何财产，以使他们能够提起诉讼或进行抗辩”，而在诉讼未决期间又可能被限制行动甚至囚禁时，他们如何能指望获得自己渴望的自由？
然而，深度投入于税收榨取和“秩序”维持的国家，断然驳回了废奴的理由。代理总督 John Adam（1823年1—8月）及其继任者 William Amherst（1823—1828）一致认为，奴隶制与人民的“习俗和感情”交织在一起。因此，干预只会引起不满，冒着造成麻烦的风险并不明智。

en: In the 1833 East India Charter Act, Parliament inserted a clause stating that slavery would be abolished in the Indian territories by 12 April 1837.
The EIC’s Court of Directors responded that they would only approve of legislation against slavery if it did not do “violence to the feelings of Caste, or the rights of property.”
The original clause was even modified to state that no regulation would be passed without “due regard to the laws of marriage, and the rights and authorities of fathers.”

This is not surprising because the terms of discussion had already been set when caste was relegated to the religious domain in 1772. This meant, paradoxically and perversely, that any acknowledgment of the caste-slavery relationship could only serve to strengthen the argument
intervention and abolition.
zh: 在1833年《东印度特许状法》中，议会加入了一项条款，规定至1837年4月12日应在印度领土废除奴隶制。
东印度公司董事会回应称，只有反奴隶制立法不“损害种姓感情或财产权”，他们才会批准。
原始条款甚至被修改为：未经“适当顾及婚姻法，以及父亲的权利和权威”，不得通过任何法规。
这一点并不令人意外，因为1772年把种姓归入宗教领域时，讨论的基本条件便已确定。其结果荒谬而悖谬：任何对种姓与奴隶制关系的承认，都只会加强
干预和废奴的论据。

en: The Law Commission sanctioned by the 1833 Charter was set up in 1835, but the Report on Slavery—which is the chief evidentiary basis of this essay—was published after significant delay in 1841. Even then, the defenders of slavery in both India and Britain kept insisting that abolition would make landowners and noblemen indignant; that laborers would become idle and unproductive without “correction” and coercion; and that slavery in India was “nothing more than an affair of caste.”

Faced with such vicious opposition, the opponents of slavery chose the easy way out. Instead of arguing that relegating caste to the domain of religion had been a mistake from the beginning, abolitionists conceded the artificial distinction between caste and slavery. They ended up being narrowly legalistic, and they wrongly assumed that caste distinctions would cease to matter in a regime of “free labor.”
Act V, passed on 7 April 1843, argued only for the legal non-recognition of slavery and did not actively declare anyone free.

Even this half-hearted measure was applied selectively, and the colonial state continued to return alleged slaves to their masters. The principal aim, always, was the extraction of revenue and the control of labor.
zh: 1833年特许状授权设立的法律委员会，于1835年成立；但作为本文主要证据基础的《奴隶制报告》，经历重大延误，直到1841年才出版。即便如此，印度与英国的奴隶制捍卫者仍坚持说：废奴会激怒地主与贵族；没有“惩戒”和强制，劳动者会变得懒散而无生产力；印度的奴隶制“不过是种姓事务”。
面对如此凶狠的反对，奴隶制的反对者选择了较容易的出路。他们没有论证，把种姓归入宗教领域从一开始就是错误，而是接受了种姓与奴隶制之间的人为区分。他们最终陷入狭隘的法律主义，并错误地假设，在“自由劳动”制度下，种姓差异将不再重要。
1843年4月7日通过的第五号法令，仅规定在法律上不承认奴隶制，并未主动宣布任何人自由。
即便这样一项敷衍的措施，也被选择性实施，殖民国家仍继续把被指称为奴隶者交还主人。首要目的始终是榨取税收与控制劳动。

en: These trends show that the tendency to consign caste to the religious sphere and to collude with landed elites was not new in the late nineteenth century. The policy of “religious neutrality” after 1858 meant that caste was relegated entirely to a “national social” domain beyond politics,
but the impulse itself had deeper roots. The early colonial state
precedents under “Hindu” law from scratch, whereas slavery in Mughal Bengal—especially in the eastern, frontier districts—was grounded in economic distress and was not reducible to textual dicta.

The debates between conservationists and abolitionists also show that the Orientalist trope of caste as a static, millennia-old “religious” institution expressing a uniquely Indian penchant for hierarchy was strong in early colonial India.
This view influenced Act V and it survived well into the twentieth century with negative consequences for Dalits.
zh: 这些趋势表明，把种姓归入宗教领域并与土地精英共谋的倾向，并不是十九世纪末的新事物。1858年之后的“宗教中立”政策，意味着种姓被完全归入政治之外的“民族社会”领域，
但这一冲动本身有更深的根源。早期殖民国家从无到有地在“印度教”法之下
先例，而莫卧儿孟加拉——尤其东部边疆地区——的奴隶制，则根植于经济困境，不能化约为文本训令。
保守派与废奴派之间的辩论也表明，在早期殖民印度，一种东方主义套语已经十分有力：种姓是一个静止的、延续数千年的“宗教”制度，表达着印度独有的等级偏好。
这一看法影响了第五号法令，并持续存在到二十世纪相当长的一段时间，给达利特带来负面后果。

en: This does not imply, however, that caste was merely a “colonial construction.”

Such a formulation occludes from vision longer-running South Asian social histories and the ethical-political valence of abolition in a context shaped by caste and agrarian slavery. It erases the ideological content of abolition
and cannot explain the subjectivity of the alleged slaves. Methodologically, the colonial construction thesis presupposes that any acknowledgment of the
history of caste

implies an acceptance of the Orientalist trope. If, however, caste is understood in terms of differential access to property and power—instantiated in practice as differential access to land, water, and markets, and the regulation of sexuality—then a history of caste can be written that refuses the binary of
millennia-old religious institution
merely a product of colonial governance.
zh: 然而，这并不意味着种姓仅仅是一种“殖民建构”。
这样的表述遮蔽了南亚更长期的社会史，也遮蔽了在种姓与农业奴隶制塑造的情境中，废奴所具有的伦理—政治意义。它
抹去了废奴的意识形态内容，也无法解释被指称为奴隶者的主体性。在方法上，殖民建构论预设：任何对种姓
历史的承认，都
意味着接受东方主义套语。然而，如果把种姓理解为对财产与权力的不平等获取——在实践中体现为对土地、水与市场的不平等获取，以及对性关系的规制——那么，就可以撰写一种拒绝
是延续数千年的宗教制度、
只是殖民治理产物这一二元对立的种姓史。

en: There is a long and extensive tradition of historiography that approaches caste in such terms. It shows that in the early historical era (ca. 1000 BCE–ca. 300 CE) and the early medieval period (ca. 600–1200 CE), caste formation was congruent with agrarian expansion, the need to streamline

over the control of land, and the extraction of revenue from land and markets. In other words, the growth of stratification was coeval with the emergence of patriarchy and the formation of states with fiscal bases in agriculture.
Caste was thus a way to
control resources and

control labor. Kinship relations continued to mediate social relations of labor, which meant that chattel slavery was never of major importance in India, and belonging to a “lower” caste did not automatically mean slave status.

At the same time, some groups existed only on the fringes of the absorptive process of sedentarization. They were simultaneously excluded (both spatially and socially) and yet included within the system as super-exploited laborers. These “outcaste” or “untouchable” communities varied widely across South Asia in terms of their ethnic and cultural identities, and the concept of untouchability ultimately depends on a vague, Brahmanical notion of ritual pollution. Nevertheless, all Indian vernaculars recognize the existence of a segregated sub-population forced to perform degrading labor deemed “impure” by society at large.
Pan-Indian terms such as
do identical conceptual work.
zh: 以这些方式理解种姓，存在悠久而丰富的史学传统。这一传统表明，在早期历史时期（约公元前1000年至公元300年）与早期中世纪（约公元600—1200年），种姓的形成与农业扩张、使土地控制权的
有序化的需要，以及从土地与市场征收税收的需要相契合。换言之，社会分层的发展，与父权制的出现和以农业为财政基础的国家的形成同步。
因此，种姓是一种
控制资源、
控制劳动的方式。亲属关系持续中介着劳动的社会关系，这意味着动产奴隶制在印度从未占据主要地位，属于“较低”种姓也不自动意味着具有奴隶身份。
与此同时，有些群体仅存在于定居化吸纳过程的边缘。他们一方面在空间上与社会上遭到排斥，另一方面又作为遭受超额剥削的劳动者被纳入这一制度。这些“种姓之外”或“不可接触者”社群，在南亚各地具有十分不同的族群与文化身份；而不可接触性的概念，归根结底依赖一种模糊的婆罗门式仪式污染观念。不过，印度所有地方语言都承认存在一个被隔离的人口群体，他们被迫从事整个社会视为“不洁”的卑贱劳动。
这类泛印度术语，发挥着同样的概念作用。

en: Early medieval Bengal was no exception to these trends. The two major ruling dynasties—the Palas (ca. 750–1162 CE) and the Senas (ca. 1070–1230 CE)—were explicitly committed to the maintenance of a normative caste order.

They made land grants on a large scale to upper castes, and the collection of revenue from these lands, cultivated by labor that was ranked as “low caste,” was the fiscal basis of the state. From the late ninth century onward, grants began to mention the entire caste spectrum with varying degrees of access to land: Brahmans were at the top and the “untouchable” Chandalas (the “lowest of the mortals”) were at the bottom.

Sources from the early centuries of the second millennium CE show that the lowest castes involved in agrarian and other forms of menial labor—such as the Chamars, the Chandalas, and the Doms—were kept spatially segregated, and they lived outside the boundaries of political capitals and upper-caste rural settlements.

We have no way of estimating variations in the size of these communities over time, but that is a function of silences in the archive. Recent scholarship on slavery in medieval South India and Mughal South Asia has emphasized the challenges posed by such processes of “invisibilization.”
zh: 早期中世纪的孟加拉并不例外。两个主要统治王朝——波罗王朝（约公元750—1162年）与犀那王朝（约公元1070—1230年）——明确致力于维持规范性的种姓秩序。
它们大规模向高种姓授予土地，向这些由被列为“低种姓”的劳动力耕种的土地征税，构成国家的财政基础。从九世纪晚期起，授地文书开始提及具有不同土地获取程度的整个种姓序列：婆罗门居于顶端，“不可接触”的Chandala（“凡人中最低等者”）居于底端。
公元第二个千年最初几个世纪的资料表明，从事农业及其他卑贱劳动的最低种姓，例如Chamar、Chandala和Dom，在空间上被隔离，居住在政治都城和高种姓乡村聚落的边界之外。
我们无法估计这些社群的人口规模随时间发生的变化，但这是档案沉默的结果。最近有关中世纪南印度和莫卧儿南亚奴隶制的研究，强调了这种“隐形化”过程带来的挑战。

en: Mughal India was a vastly different context and yet caste continued to be

in new ways. The state was no longer explicitly committed to a normative caste order and the agrarian revenue system was sprawling and complex. At the village and sub-regional levels, however, a caste-based hierarchical structure remained the basic framework in much of the subcontinent.
Peasants had customary rights of usage, but they were tied to the land, which they could neither freely alienate nor desert at will.

In Bengal, the vast majority of field labor continued to be performed by middling and lower castes, including those deemed untouchable, whereas the largest estates were controlled by the ritually highest-ranked Brahmans and the powerful Kayasthas.
Indeed, as late as 1830, Brahmans continued to hold lands at 50% lower rent than their lower-caste counterparts in some regions.
zh: 莫卧儿印度的情境已大不相同，然而，种姓仍以新的方式不断被
。国家不再明确致力于规范性的种姓秩序，农业税收制度也庞杂而复杂。不过，在村落与次区域层面，以种姓为基础的等级结构仍是次大陆大部分地区的基本框架。
农民具有习惯性的土地使用权，但被束缚于土地，既不能自由转让土地，也不能任意弃地而去。
在孟加拉，绝大多数田间劳动仍由中低种姓承担，其中包括被视为不可接触者的人；最大的地产则由仪式等级最高的婆罗门和强大的Kayastha控制。
事实上，直到1830年，在某些地区，婆罗门持有土地所支付的地租仍比低种姓对应群体低50%。

en: Slavery in Mughal Bengal was reducible neither to caste nor to timeless “Hindu” and “Muslim” laws. Rather, it was grounded in economic distress caused by famines, floods, and debt.

Faced with a choice between servitude and death, many chose the former. Deeds of sale between 1694 and 1770 show that once a sale was effected, the master had complete control over a slave and their heirs. Punishment of runaway slaves was common. Masters aimed at the extraction of maximum possible work and reserved the right to cut loose unproductive slaves in old age.

Besides voluntary sale, the internal supply of slaves was also sustained through violence—that is, the kidnapping of men, women, and children—and natural growth, since women who married or cohabited with slaves also acquired servile status and their children inherited it.
zh: 莫卧儿孟加拉的奴隶制，既不能化约为种姓，也不能化约为超越时间的“印度教”法或“穆斯林”法。相反，它根植于饥荒、洪水与债务造成的经济困境。
面对服役与死亡之间的选择，许多人选择了前者。1694至1770年的卖身契表明，一旦完成买卖，主人便完全控制奴隶及其后代。惩罚逃亡奴隶十分常见。主人力图榨取尽可能多的劳动，并保留在奴隶年老、失去生产能力时抛弃他们的权利。
除了自愿卖身，内部奴隶供给还通过暴力——即绑架男人、女人与儿童——以及自然增长得以维持，因为与奴隶结婚或同居的妇女也会获得奴役身份，而她们的子女会继承这一身份。

en: At the same time, agrarian social relations were deeply embedded in caste norms, which shaped norms of slavery in turn. Not all castes could be asked to do all kinds of labor, and upper castes could not, in general, be agrarian slaves to those of lower status.

Prices varied by caste and plummeted during famines, and slaves belonging to menial castes such as the Bagdis had to explicitly disavow the rights of their children to any property that their parents had acquired.
Many deeds of sale were written in the vernacular, which shows that the norms and expectations of caste and slavery were fully legible to all actors within Indian society.
zh: 与此同时，农业社会关系深深嵌入种姓规范之中，后者又塑造着奴隶制的规范。并非所有种姓都能被要求从事所有类型的劳动；一般而言，高种姓也不能成为身份较低者的农业奴隶。
价格因种姓而异，并在饥荒期间暴跌；属于Bagdi等卑贱种姓的奴隶，必须明确放弃子女对父母已经取得的任何财产所拥有的权利。
许多卖身契以地方语言写成，表明印度社会中的所有行动者都完全理解种姓与奴隶制的规范及预期。

en: Two apparently contradictory things could thus be simultaneously true. Economic, political, and cultural changes between the sixteenth and eighteenth centuries, which some scholars have associated with an “early modernity” in South Asia (or Eurasia more broadly), massively increased the stakes of being able to access land and markets more freely.
Commercialization and expanded division of labor meant that caste was in a state of flux and neither static nor merely religious.

Concurrently, elites attempted to tighten control over labor through slavery and a renewed emphasis on caste hierarchies. In Rajasthan and Maharashtra in western India, for example, the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries witnessed not only an increase in the incidence of slavery but also a renewed emphasis on “purity” of caste and “descent.”

The context in both provinces was one of regional assertions against Mughal rule and agrarian expansion. The slaves were not only war captives, but also those affected badly by famine and ongoing debt. They performed all kinds of labor, including military service and agrarian labor. Upward mobility among merchant castes also led to a desire for greater “distance” from those deemed untouchable, a project that was brought to fruition in alliance with the pre-colonial state of Marwar.
zh: 因此，两种看似矛盾的情况，可以同时成立。十六至十八世纪间的经济、政治与文化变化——一些学者将其与南亚（或更广泛的欧亚大陆）的“早期现代性”联系起来——大幅提高了更自由地获取土地和进入市场所涉及的利害关系。
商业化与劳动分工的扩展，意味着种姓处于变动之中，既非静止不变，也不只是宗教性的。
与此同时，精英试图通过奴隶制以及对种姓等级的重新强调，加强对劳动的控制。例如，在印度西部的拉贾斯坦和马哈拉施特拉，十七与十八世纪不仅见证了奴隶制的增多，也见证了对种姓“纯洁性”和“血统”的重新强调。
两省的背景，都是地区势力对莫卧儿统治的挑战以及农业扩张。奴隶不仅包括战俘，还包括深受饥荒和持续债务之害的人。他们从事各种劳动，包括服兵役与农业劳动。商人种姓的向上流动，也使他们希望与被视为不可接触者的人保持更大“距离”；这一计划通过与前殖民时期马尔瓦尔国家结盟而得以实现。

en: The early colonial state, by instituting a “despotism of law,” acted as a bulwark for this second trend against the first.

The conflicts over the legal status of alleged “slaves” must be read against this background. In the eastern, frontier districts of Bengal where conflicts recurred most frequently, caste formation was still inchoate. The Muslim peasantry that emerged in eastern Bengal from ca. 1574 onward was not composed of those who had earlier been “Hindu” but rather of autochthonous communities at the fringes of the agrarian order, including the Chandalas.
Upper-caste landed elites and moneylenders often forwarded the capital necessary for reclamation during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries,
but the form that agrarian social relations could take was by no means a foregone conclusion. Slavery in this context was a tool for consolidating control.
Indeed, by the eighteenth century, large estates regularly included a considerable number of slaves.
In the eastern districts of Dhaka-Jalalpur, Rajshahi, and Sylhet, slaves were also sold
the land.

Slaveholding, therefore, was especially important in frontier regions with a favorable land-labor ratio to guarantee labor supply. This is why, despite the extremely limited character of “abolition,” 580 Hindu and 700 Muslim landholders in Sylhet opposed Act V. In a petition submitted in February 1843, they claimed that hereditary slaves did not think of their situation as “degraded” and that men of “rank” had “no means of employing paid servants to perform the duties which were ordinarily performed by slaves.”
zh: 早期殖民国家通过建立一种“法律专制”，成为第二种趋势抵御第一种趋势的堡垒。
必须在这一背景下理解围绕所谓“奴隶”法律身份发生的冲突。在冲突最频繁的孟加拉东部边疆地区，种姓形成仍处于初始阶段。约自1574年起出现在孟加拉东部的穆斯林农民，并非由此前属于“印度教”的人组成，而是由农业秩序边缘的本土社群组成，其中包括Chandala。
十七与十八世纪，高种姓土地精英和放贷者经常预付开垦所需的资本，
但农业社会关系可能采取何种形式，绝非预先确定。在这一情境中，奴隶制是巩固控制的工具。
事实上，到十八世纪，大地产通常拥有数量可观的奴隶。
在东部的达卡—贾拉尔普尔、拉杰沙希和锡尔赫特地区，奴隶也会
土地出售。
因此，在地多人少的边疆地区，拥有奴隶对于保障劳动力供给尤为重要。这就是为什么，尽管“废奴”的性质极其有限，锡尔赫特的580名印度教地主与700名穆斯林地主仍反对第五号法令。他们在1843年2月提交的请愿书中声称，世袭奴隶并不认为自己的处境“卑下”，而有“身份”的人也“没有办法雇用付薪仆役，来履行通常由奴隶履行的职责”。

en: Thus, the alleged “slaves” in legal conflicts challenged not only slavery but also the

that produced and reproduced caste: the control of access to land and labor. The challenge was not articulated in language or texts. Nor does the evidence imply a coherent ideology of abolitionism. Nevertheless, action and thought cannot be artificially separated. By challenging established practices of slavery against all odds, the enslaved thereby

a critique of caste in practice. Arguably, such a practical challenge was more worrisome for those in power than a textual exegesis that did not necessarily challenge the practices that constituted caste. Why else, we might ask, were landholders in frontier districts so concerned about the toothless “abolition” of the colonial state?
zh: 因此，法律冲突中被指称为“奴隶”的人，不仅挑战了奴隶制，也挑战了生产和再生产种姓的
：控制土地与劳动的获取。这种挑战并未以语言或文本明确表达。证据也不意味着存在一种连贯的废奴意识形态。尽管如此，行动与思想不能被人为分开。被奴役者克服重重阻力，挑战既有的奴隶制实践，由此在实践中
了对种姓的批判。可以说，对掌权者而言，这种实际挑战比文本诠释更令人忧虑，因为后者未必挑战构成种姓的实践。否则，我们不禁要问，边疆地区的地主为何如此担忧殖民国家那毫无力度的“废奴”？

en: Reading evidence from the colonial archive in terms of a larger structure of inference is not uncommon in a field of study where direct access to the mental life of historical subjects is virtually impossible. In his influential work, Thomas Holt also inferred what the emancipated black workers
by looking at what they

Although Holt had no evidence of actual statements made by the emancipated, he asked what kind of commitments could help us make sense of the actions they undertook. Fraught as this interpretive exercise is, it enabled Holt to situate the Jamaican case within broader debates about abolition, racism, and capitalism. This essay attempts something similar on a smaller scale for India, and unlike Holt, I do have evidence where the alleged “slaves” speak, albeit through the mediation of the colonial state.
zh: 在一个几乎不可能直接进入历史主体精神生活的研究领域，把殖民档案中的证据放入更大的推论结构来解读，并不少见。托马斯·霍尔特在其影响深远的著作中，同样通过考察获得解放的黑人工人
，推断他们
。虽然霍尔特没有获得解放者实际言论的证据，他仍追问：何种信念能够帮助我们理解他们采取的行动？这一诠释实践虽充满困难，却使霍尔特能够把牙买加的案例置于有关废奴、种族主义和资本主义的更广泛辩论之中。本文试图在较小的尺度上，对印度进行类似尝试；与霍尔特不同的是，我确实拥有被指称为“奴隶”者发声的证据，尽管这种发声经过殖民国家的中介。

en: Does the fact of this mediation make the archive unusable? Not necessarily. Scholars of the Atlantic world have been engaged in a lively debate for decades about how to access the subjectivity of the enslaved.
There is a broad consensus that legal conflicts recorded in colonial archives make social fault lines legible, and at certain moments in such conflicts even the enslaved could “speak.”

Despite the difference in context, the stakes involved are strikingly similar for South Asia: writing about and interpreting the actions of entire communities that have been deliberately “invisibilized” in the archive. Like their Atlantic counterparts, scholars of Indian Ocean slavery have recently noted that careful attention to legal conflicts and the indexing of court cases might enable an archivally grounded “global subaltern (social) history.”
This essay seeks to contribute to and deepen such conversations.
zh: 这一中介事实，是否使档案变得无法使用？未必。大西洋世界的研究者几十年来一直热烈讨论，如何接近被奴役者的主体性。
学界广泛认同，殖民档案记录的法律冲突，使社会断裂线变得可辨；而在此类冲突的某些时刻，甚至被奴役者也能够“说话”。
尽管情境不同，南亚所涉及的利害关系却惊人地相似：书写并解释那些在档案中遭到刻意“隐形化”的整个社群的行动。与大西洋研究者一样，印度洋奴隶制研究者近来也指出，仔细关注法律冲突并为法庭案件编制索引，可能使一种立足档案的“全球底层（社会）史”成为可能。
本文试图参与并深化这些讨论。

en: At the same time, the colonial archive was politically constituted and historically specific. Although the Charter Act of 1813 has received far greater attention from historians due to its major implications for the future of Indian industry, the Act of 1833 was no less consequential politically.

It transferred the entire responsibility of governance and policymaking to a company-state invested in revenue extraction, and the India Question dropped out of the British Parliament completely. It also espoused an authoritarian vision of “reform” led by Thomas Macaulay, who chaired the Law Commission that produced the Report on Slavery. Thus, when Lord Brougham raised the issue of Indian slavery in Parliament on 5 October 1841, Lord Ellenborough responded that “Parliament had wisely directed that the initiation in legislation on this subject should be left with the Governor-General and council.”

Indeed, Ellenborough, who oversaw the passing of Act V as Governor-General of India between February 1842 and June 1844, had denounced the clause in the 1833 Act regarding abolition as “useless and unnecessary.” It would, he thought, “excite the indignation of the landed proprietors” and “shake the confidence and the allegiance of the native officers.”
zh: 与此同时，殖民档案是政治性建构的产物，并具有特定的历史性。虽然1813年《特许状法》因对印度工业前景产生重大影响，而获得历史学家更多关注，但1833年法令的政治后果同样深远。
它把治理与政策制定的全部责任，移交给一个致力于税收榨取的公司国家，印度问题也彻底退出英国议会的议程。它还倡导一种由托马斯·麦考莱主导的威权“改革”愿景；麦考莱主持的法律委员会编写了《奴隶制报告》。因此，当布鲁厄姆勋爵于1841年10月5日在议会提出印度奴隶制问题时，埃伦伯勒勋爵回应说：“议会明智地规定，有关这一议题的立法创议，应留给总督及其参事会。”
事实上，埃伦伯勒于1842年2月至1844年6月担任印度总督，其间监督第五号法令的通过，却曾谴责1833年法令中有关废奴的条款“毫无用处，也无必要”。他认为，它将“激起土地所有者的愤慨”，并“动摇本土军官的信心与忠诚”。

en: The early colonial state, therefore, was a force of reaction, but such forces were ascendant at the time not only in India but throughout the wider imperial world

within Europe and Britain. Most officials who governed India—even “Whigs” such as Macaulay who considered it necessary to appeal to the interests of the rising middle classes and “the democracy”—were political proponents of “order” and reform from above.

They opposed democratic, working-class movements everywhere including Chartism in Britain. Thus, Lord Ellenborough called the movement for electoral reform “a monstrous democracy,” and Robert Peel, who was Prime Minister (1841–1846) in 1843, called it “a reckless democracy.”

The reform that did occur secured the influence of the landed elite in Parliament and separated a section of the middle classes from proletarian workers by including the former within the political system.
Abolition, in this context, functioned like “moral capital” for a British Empire seeking atonement for the “sin” of slavery, which had led, many believed, to the loss of the American colonies.
Antislavery appealed to political elites because it enabled Parliament to keep flying the flag of liberty at a time when it was clamping down on liberties both at home and abroad.
zh: 因此，早期殖民国家是一股反动力量；但当时，此类力量不仅在印度，也在更广阔的帝国世界
欧洲和英国国内占据上风。治理印度的大多数官员——甚至包括麦考莱这样的“辉格党人”，他们认为必须诉诸正在兴起的中产阶级及“民主力量”的利益——在政治上都主张“秩序”与自上而下的改革。
他们反对各地的民主工人运动，包括英国的宪章运动。因此，埃伦伯勒勋爵把选举改革运动称为“一种骇人的民主”，而在1843年担任首相的罗伯特·皮尔（任期1841—1846年）则称其为“一种鲁莽的民主”。
实际发生的改革，巩固了土地精英在议会中的影响，并通过把部分中产阶级纳入政治制度，使他们与无产阶级工人分离。
在这一背景下，废奴如同一种“道德资本”，供大英帝国为奴隶制的“罪孽”寻求赎罪；许多人相信，正是这一罪孽导致了美洲殖民地的丧失。
反奴隶制之所以吸引政治精英，是因为它使议会能够在压制国内外自由的同时，继续高举自由旗帜。

en: By thus historicizing the colonial archive, we can grasp the contradictions of abolition in South Asia in a dialectical manner. In an agrarian society shaped by caste and slavery, formal freedom and personal liberty mattered. Thus, the claim by Dalit studies scholars about the utility of “colonial” liberalism and modernity for Dalits is historically valid. In Bengal, Lockean claims about the constitution of property by labor shaped agrarian politics from the 1860s onward, well into the twentieth century.
Such claims were already present in embryonic form in the

peasant rebellion (1825–1833) in the eastern frontier district of Mymensingh. Here, hill tribes such as the Garos, the Hajongs, and the Hadis, who were being incorporated into a settled agrarian order as

castes, resisted increased revenue assessment. They claimed that since it was through their labor (or of their forefathers) that forests had been reclaimed and the land made to bear fruit, the incremental profit and higher rent that resulted from the increased settlement in the region should accrue to them and not to the landlords or the state.

Indeed, the connection between land, labor, and property was first made by the proponents of Faraizism, an Islamic reformist movement that emerged to prominence among the weavers and cultivators of eastern Bengal in the 1820s.
Their slogan—
, that is, the land belongs to the owner of the plough that tills it—inspired communist-led agrarian movements in Bengal throughout the twentieth century.
zh: 如此将殖民档案历史化，我们便能以辩证方式把握南亚废奴的矛盾。在由种姓与奴隶制塑造的农业社会中，形式自由与人身自由确有意义。因此，达利特研究学者有关“殖民”自由主义和现代性对达利特有用的主张，在历史上是成立的。在孟加拉，从1860年代一直到二十世纪相当长的一段时期，劳动构成财产的洛克式主张塑造着农业政治。
这类主张已经以萌芽形式存在于东部边疆迈门辛地区的
农民起义（1825—1833年）中。在那里，Garo、Hajong和Hadi等山地部落，正作为
种姓被纳入定居农业秩序，他们抵制税额的增加。他们声称，既然森林是通过他们（或其祖先）的劳动开垦的，土地也是因此才结出果实，那么，由该地区定居扩展所带来的利润增量和更高地租，就应归他们所有，而非归地主或国家所有。
事实上，最先把土地、劳动与财产联系起来的，是Faraizism的倡导者；这是一场伊斯兰改革运动，1820年代在孟加拉东部的织工与耕作者中兴起并获得影响。
他们的口号——
，即土地属于耕作它的犁的主人——在整个二十世纪激励着孟加拉由共产党领导的农业运动。

en: By claiming that

labor irrespective of caste status should be seen as constituting property equally, peasants articulated a profound critique of caste as a regime where different categories of persons were understood to be engaged in qualitatively distinct forms of labor, and those who labored the most were perpetually propertyless. Such claims, though, could only be made by tenants and not by slaves treated as property. Given that legal conflicts recurred most frequently in the eastern districts with surplus land, there can be little doubt that this was one of the reasons why slaves wanted to assert a property right over their own bodies and labor. The relevance of abolition in South Asia, therefore, cannot be reduced to the contingent requirements of colonial governance and empire.
zh: 农民主张，不论种姓身份如何，
劳动都应被视为同等地构成财产，由此对种姓制度提出深刻批判：在这一制度中，不同类别的人被理解为从事性质不同的劳动，而劳动最多的人始终没有财产。然而，这类主张只能由佃农提出，不能由被视为财产的奴隶提出。鉴于法律冲突最频繁地出现在土地有余的东部地区，几乎可以确定，这正是奴隶希望主张对自身身体与劳动拥有财产权的原因之一。因此，南亚废奴的意义，不能被化约为殖民治理与帝国的偶然需要。

en: Nevertheless, Act V, and liberalism in South Asia more broadly, functioned as tools of empire in a historical moment of counter-revolution that laid bare the emergent contradictions of capitalism. Massive proletarianization had brought the question of mass democracy and socialist transformation to the fore in Europe, which meant, as Marx insisted, that classical bourgeois revolutions were no longer feasible. There could only be counter-revolutions defending already constituted property, or social-republican revolutions against the capitalist order.
zh: 尽管如此，第五号法令，以及更广义上的南亚自由主义，在一个反革命的历史时刻充当着帝国的工具；这一时刻暴露了资本主义新出现的矛盾。大规模无产阶级化，使大众民主与社会主义改造问题在欧洲凸显；这意味着，正如马克思所坚持的，经典的资产阶级革命已不再可能。可能存在的，只有保卫既成财产的反革命，或者反对资本主义秩序的社会共和主义革命。

en: This point brings to light the limits of abolitionists in South Asia who conceded the artificial distinction between caste and slavery. By the late eighteenth century, the practices that ensured differential access to property and power had created a

separation between propertyless and propertied castes, which provided the grounds for the emergence of specifically capitalist labor relations. This can be discerned from the fact that in the early nineteenth century, a floating, rural proletariat existed in most parts of India, and, when industrialization began, the necessary labor was drawn primarily from this floating proletariat consisting of the lowest castes.

Therefore, scholars who argue that the lack of classic primitive accumulation in India is one reason for the distinctive character of capitalism in the region are only partly correct, because they ignore the long-running history of caste and the incorporation and reconstitution of caste within capitalism.

Lockean claims to property were ill-equipped to respond to these complexities, which explains why such arguments could function as a defense of the status quo—that is, a caste-differentiated distribution of property—by the 1910s.
zh: 这一点揭示了南亚废奴主义者的局限：他们接受了种姓与奴隶制之间的人为区分。到十八世纪末，确保人们不平等地获取财产与权力的实践，已经在无产种姓和有产种姓之间造成
分离，为特别具有资本主义性质的劳动关系的出现提供了基础。这可以从以下事实看出：十九世纪初，印度大部分地区都存在一个流动的农村无产阶级；工业化开始时，所需劳动力主要来自这个由最低种姓组成的流动无产阶级。
因此，某些学者认为，印度缺少经典的原始积累，是该地区资本主义具有独特性质的原因之一；他们只说对了一部分，因为他们忽视了种姓的漫长历史，也忽视了种姓被纳入资本主义并在其中重新构成的过程。
洛克式财产主张难以应对这些复杂情况；这解释了为什么到1910年代，此类论证能够起到维护现状——即依种姓区别分配财产——的作用。

en: Though ultimately unsuccessful, the slogan of “forty acres and a mule” to the formerly enslaved was at least raised in the era of Reconstruction in the southern United States.

Something equally radical would have been necessary in India to resemble anything like a level playing field, but the counter-revolution of property, backed by an extractive colonial state, was even stronger. These contextual and political factors explain the failures and limits of liberty and abolition in South Asia, not the inability of the colonial state to understand the “slavery-to-kinship continuum,” or a purported attempt to smuggle in “European concepts of liberty and ‘possessive individualism.’”
zh: 在美国南部的重建时期，虽然最终未能实现，但至少曾有人为昔日被奴役者提出“四十英亩土地和一头骡子”的口号。
在印度，要形成任何近似公平的起点，同样需要激进的措施；然而，榨取性的殖民国家所支持的财产反革命更加强大。正是这些具体情境与政治因素，解释了南亚自由与废奴的失败和局限，而不是殖民国家无法理解“从奴隶制到亲属关系的连续谱”，也不是它据称试图偷偷引入“欧洲的自由概念和‘占有性个人主义’”。

en: Conclusion
zh: 结论

en: The contemporary literature on Indian Ocean slavery speaks to many themes broached in this essay. Scholars have shown that wages and loans, and the formal freedom they embodied, were not unimportant. Wages were used to purchase manumission in the Cape colonies, and freedom in the Indian Ocean often meant working for a wage.
“Flight” represented “fight,” and the lack of large-scale slave rebellions compared to the Atlantic does not imply a lack of resistance.
Rebellion against extractive empires and deeply rooted indigenous power structures was not easy, and any resistance we find in the archive requires a historical explanation.
zh: 当代有关印度洋奴隶制的文献，回应了本文提出的许多主题。学者们表明，工资与贷款，以及它们体现的形式自由，并非无关紧要。在开普殖民地，人们用工资购买解放身份；印度洋地区的自由，也往往意味着为工资而劳动。
“逃亡”代表着“斗争”；与大西洋相比，缺少大规模奴隶起义，并不意味着缺少抵抗。
反抗榨取性的帝国和根深蒂固的本土权力结构并不容易；我们在档案中发现的任何抵抗，都需要历史解释。

en: New research on global histories of slavery, however, has not inspired attempts to write global histories of antislavery. The Atlantic-centered debate is rarely invoked today, and the dialectical approach of major contributors to that debate has been jettisoned in favor of a purely negative view of capitalism as

imperial and racist. The obverse of this tendency is the conceptualization of “resistance” as challenges only to extractive European empires, which leaves open the possibility of an uncritical affirmation of pre-colonial South Asian societies.
zh: 然而，有关奴隶制全球史的新研究，并未促成书写反奴隶制全球史的尝试。如今，以大西洋为中心的辩论很少被援引，那场辩论中主要参与者的辩证方法也被抛弃，取而代之的是一种对资本主义纯然否定的看法：资本主义
具有帝国主义与种族主义性质。这一倾向的另一面，是把“抵抗”仅仅理解为对榨取性的欧洲帝国的挑战，从而留下了不加批判地肯定前殖民南亚社会的可能。

en: By contrast, this essay has argued that combining insights from the antislavery debate with the extensive literature on caste in India offers two benefits. One, it brings into sharp relief contradictions within Indian society, and thereby shows how and why abolition and the formal freedom of wage-labor mattered in that context. Those alleged to be “slaves” expressed dissatisfaction with the legal or
status of complete ownership, whereas their indigenous masters argued that such rights existed
in Bengali society. The “slaves” insisted that they had sold their
to labor in return for wages and loans, and not their personhood. Such claims were motivated by a desire for personal liberty: a desire to
something other than a “slave,” based on a recognition of the
involved in it.
zh: 相较之下，本文认为，将反奴隶制辩论的洞见与有关印度种姓的丰富文献结合起来，有两方面益处。第一，它使印度社会内部的矛盾鲜明呈现，从而表明，在这一情境中，废奴以及雇佣劳动的形式自由如何、又为何重要。被指称为“奴隶”的人，对被完全占有的法律身份或
身份表达不满；他们的本土主人则主张，这些权利在孟加拉社会
存在。“奴隶”坚持说，他们出售的是劳动
，以换取工资与贷款，而不是自己的人格。这类主张由对人身自由的渴望所推动：他们认识到其中的
，因而渴望
“奴隶”以外的某种人。

en: The colonial state and the global, capitalist context of counter-revolution smothered these aspirations. By thus historicizing both the potentials and failures of liberty, we can think about comparison in a grounded manner, one that does not proceed from
assumptions either about the equivalence of “caste” and “race,” or about a
connection between capitalism, slavery, and racism.

Close attention to the specificities of caste, slavery, and social aspirations within South Asia, and archivally grounded arguments about how and when they came to be mediated by the history of capitalism, can obviate the need to fit regional histories into yet another Atlantic-centric notion such as “racial capitalism.” At stake is a deeper understanding of how global capitalism has unevenly incorporated pre-capitalist social forms within it and reconstituted them over time.
zh: 殖民国家，以及全球资本主义反革命的背景，扼杀了这些愿望。如此将自由的潜能与失败一并历史化，我们就能以扎实的方式思考比较，而不从有关“种姓”与“种族”等同、或资本主义、奴隶制与种族主义之间存在
联系的
假设出发。

en: The colonial state consistently used the sociological category of “cultivator” interchangeably with the legal category of “tenant.” In practice, though, the two statuses did not always overlap, because as the revenue chain expanded, a legally defined tenant was often a rent-collector from under-tenants who cultivated the land.
